The **Amalgamation** is a powerful bound construct created by the [[Secretive Brotherhood]] to serve as the guardian of their [[Grand Archive]] within the [[Asymmetrical Mountain]].

## Role and History
Described in Brotherhood records as the archive's ultimate protector, the Amalgamation was stationed beyond the archive's sealed door. Its primary function was to defend the repository's knowledge from any unauthorized intrusion. The construct's existence is known primarily from archival inscriptions and recovered lore.
